notes:
[TXT029-infimum] Manuscript page 28 names the constructed infimum for ≪ the “figure intersection” F.G. It distinguishes this from the ordinary intersection F∩G of the families, saying the two coincide for compatible figures. It states that the construction works for an arbitrary family and writes |∧F_i|=∩|F_i|. These existence and compatibility assertions were read as statements, not independently established here. The missing verb in “où F et G compatibles” is retained.

[TXT029-name] The final named property remains modération/médiation, underlined and in double quotes; H’s demi-treillis is not in the ink. The preceding verb is l’apparente/s’apparente, with l first on its nearly upright initial. The cancelled phrase before à une propriété may be la priorité: a fivefold enlargement exposes only one p descender. These doubts remain in place.

[TXT029-cancelled] The three-line Propriété at the foot is cancelled. It states F′≼F implies F′.G≼F.G and adds “Immédit/Immédiat sur supports”, then “Subdivision induite sur/par un raffinement”. A wider view showed that the apparent p stem in the last preposition was a cancellation stroke, so sur/par is left uncertain. The check of equal supports is conditional on |F′|=|F| and the displayed support formula. It does not verify the full subdivision relation. R3 also checked the abstract monotonicity of meet in one preorder, explicitly distinguishing it from the manuscript’s separate subdivision relation.

No explicit question mark or à vérifier, date, title sheet or page count appears. The only page identifier is handwritten 28. The small brown damaged mark before l’appelle remains uncertain even as an erased-letter attribution.
